summary.diagnosis:
*Aug 26→Sep 1 vs Aug 19→Aug 25* · Revenue -53% (60,069 vs 127,054 EGP) · Spend -48% · ROAS 2.37 (-9%).
   • CPC: 11.07 → 9.35 EGP (-16%, down (good))
   • CVR: 1.7% → 1.11% (-35%, down (drag))
   • AOV: 1,694 → 2,002 EGP (+18%, up (good))
   *Who moved it:* *CVR 56%* of the move (hurt, -32,045 EGP)  ·  *CPC 22%* of the move (helped, +4,666 EGP)  ·  *AOV 22%* of the move (helped, +9,240 EGP).
   *Read:* *CVR* fell -35%, the biggest of the three.
     Worth about *-32,045 EGP of revenue at the same clicks*.
     That drove ROAS -9%.
     Revenue -53% because spend -48%.
   *Deeper:* biggest single mover was *Big personality catalogue   06-28*, its CVR went 4.55%→1.51% on 4,707 EGP spend (~91% of the swing).
